chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from al-Abbas ibn Amir, from Dawud ibn al-Husayn, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Breastfeeding after two years, before weaning, causes prohibition (of marriage), because this report is consistent with the Sunni view, and it was issued in the manner of precautionary piety (taqiyyah).
ai.seo_question: Does breastfeeding after two years cause marital prohibition in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that breastfeeding after the first two years but before complete weaning establishes marital prohibition, a ruling aligned with the Sunni consensus. The Imam notes that this report was presented in the manner of *taqiyyah*, reflecting the Shia scholarly practice of adapting legal statements to prevailing contexts or avoiding conflict while maintaining jurisprudential accuracy.
